headword: {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い

definitions.explanation: A seasonal greeting card or message sent during the hottest part of summer (roughly mid-July to early August) to inquire after someone's well-being. One of several traditional seasonal greeting customs in Japan, along with New Year's cards.

examples.japanese: {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent out summer greeting cards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハガキ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a summer greeting postcard to my teacher.

examples.japanese: {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I extend my midsummer greetings to you. (standard opening phrase)

examples.japanese: ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{残暑見舞|ざんしょみま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the start of autumn on the traditional calendar, it becomes a late-summer greeting rather than a midsummer greeting.

notes:
Composed of {暑中|しょちゅう} (the heat of midsummer; the hottest period) and ⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧ (inquiry after someone's health; a visit or greeting of sympathy). Literally "midsummer health inquiry."

This is one of Japan's important seasonal correspondence customs. Cards are sent during the period called {暑中|しょちゅう}, roughly from mid-July until ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧ (start of autumn, around August 7). After ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧, the same type of greeting shifts to {残暑見舞|ざんしょみま}い (late-summer greeting).

The standard opening phrase on these cards is {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧, a highly formal expression of seasonal well-wishing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send summer greeting cards
- {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハガキ: summer greeting postcard
- {暑中見舞|しょちゅうみま}い⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: standard summer greeting phrase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧: New Year's card — the other major seasonal greeting card tradition
- {残暑見舞|ざんしょみま}い: late-summer greeting — sent after ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧, when the summer heat lingers
- {寒中見舞|かんちゅうみま}い: midwinter greeting — the winter equivalent
